text:
Maria: quick noteap-southeast1 showing a backlog: ~120 GPU pods Pending after midnight scheduler rollout. Most hang on prebind/taint handshake.
SRE-Bot: alert: gpu-prod-ap-southeast1 pending_pods=123 severity=warning dashboard=https://console/reports/alerts/1742005678
Devon: that rollout included the prebind aggressive change, right? we bumped window to 7s last night.
Li: yes. logs show a lot of "prebind: waiting for taint-prop" and kubelet attach queue saturation.
Kai: paste from scheduler:
```
I0503 01:02:11 prebind.go: wait=6.9s pod=training-job-42 node=gpux-apse1b-03
W0503 01:02:15 attach: nvattach queue depth=100/100 backpressure=high
```
Maria: Ops, can we roll the prebind change back for ap-southeast1 only? prefer rollout guard vs full revert.
Ops: starting targeted rollback to ap-southeast1a/b canary now. will report within 5m.
Devon: short mitigation: also consider increasing attach-concurrency on kubelet from 4->12 in apac temporarily. reduces mount timeouts.
Li: agreed, but let's canary rollback first. attach-concurrency canary after.
Ops: rollback canary done for a/b at 1742005780. pending dropped 123 -> 55 in ~2m.
SRE-Bot: incident: status=mitigated metric=gpu_pending_ap-southeast1 link=https://console/infra/metrics/gpu-pending/1742005678
Maria: good signal. deploying attach-concurrency canary (10% nodes).
Kai: after both actions pending down to ~18, eviction churn stopped. temporary mitigation successful.
Devon: follow-up items: add region guard to scheduler feature flagging, and make prebind-window adaptive to per-region taint/conntrack p95.
Li: file created: INF-3728 with logs, spike chart, and suggested fixes.
Maria: I'll draft a short postmortem and include a cost calc for idle GPU minutes.
Ops: closing canary thread for now. reopen if pending >50 for 15m. :thumbsup:
